artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan fixing the books hard agent's artifacts/status template, both hard skills' hand-rolled task lookups, and the full-tier ambiguity behind the general defect.

memory_candidates.content: A declared `**Verification Tier**: full` in a plan is documentation only -- nothing mechanically ties it to an actual `verify-deploy.sh` invocation. validate-artifact.sh checks the field's PRESENCE (and only in --strict), never whether a full-tier phase's own task list reaches a full-gate command. Consequence observed twice independently in this repo: a plan declares `full`, its phase checklist names three hand-picked validators instead, the completion postflight passes, and standing lint failures in the task's own new files survive into the tree. When authoring or reviewing a `full`-tier phase, require the phase's verification criteria to name `bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh` (source store: agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh) or the complete set of gates it aggregates -- a self-chosen validator subset satisfies the letter of the prose but not the tier.
